title: finding(components,a11y,i18n): `RefreshIndicator` defaults its accessible name to the English literal "Refreshing", and four renderers pass none
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites (class a): every non-English screen-reader user hears an English progress name on four data views. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#7237 dev report (PR objectui#10539). The contract reviewer grep-confirmed all four sites; the seat recorded it on ACCEPT `5828941594`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

- `packages/components/src/custom/refresh-indicator.tsx`: `ariaLabel = "Refreshing"` is the default (~:53), rendered as `aria-label` on a `role="progressbar"` (~:69–71). The prop's docblock says 'Defaults to "Refreshing"'.
- These renderers pass no `ariaLabel`, so they take the English default:
  - `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:~5684`
  - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:~4818`
  - `plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:~1516`
  - `plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx:~1053`
- The one caller that translates: `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:~2207` passes `ariaLabel={t('gantt.aria.refreshing')}`.
- Keys already in every built-in locale: `grid.refreshing` and `list.refreshing`. `ObjectGrid` and `ListView` already read them for their pull-to-refresh text (~:5690 / ~:4156). `calendar.refreshing` exists too. The seat found no `chart` or dashboard-table key.

This is the objectui#3546 class: text a user meets that bypasses the translation layer.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each of the four callers passes its translated name (grid and list reuse their keys; chart and data table need one).
- Whether the shared component should keep an English default at all is triage's call. Tightening it, by making `ariaLabel` required or dropping the default, is the "declaration enforces" option. It moves a published prop, so it would carry `Clause-②: yes`.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z):
- `RefreshIndicator` ⇒ 3 hits: the seat post, PR objectui#10539 (the origin), PR objectui#10494 (the in-place refresh that introduced two callers). None is this defect;
- `Refreshing` near `aria|accessible|English` ⇒ 1 hit, PR objectui#10539 (the origin).
